description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three text annotation tools — TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT — across two categories of Twitter data: “Emoji Tweets” (tweets containing emojis) and “Overall Tweet” (all tweets, including those with and without emojis). The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2. For “Emoji Tweets,” TEXTBLOB (white bar) achieves approximately 0.35 accuracy, VADER (hatched bar) reaches about 0.55, and ChatGPT (solid green bar) attains roughly 0.68. In the “Overall Tweet” category, TEXTBLOB drops slightly to around 0.3, VADER remains near 0.55, and ChatGPT maintains high performance at approximately 0.65. The chart visually emphasizes ChatGPT’s superior accuracy in both categories, particularly in emoji-containing tweets, while TEXTBLOB consistently underperforms. The legend on the right identifies each tool by its bar pattern and color, and the chart title “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis” indicates the comparative scope of the evaluation.
